title: Orchestrator run-command executor
description: Run a command with an env file and write its first stdout line into that env file

command.description: Command to run (executable plus its subcommands), executed through the shell

args.description: Extra arguments appended to the command

env.description: Extra environment variables for the child

envFile.description: Env file loaded into the child env and written by envKey

envKey.description: Env file key that receives the captured stdout value

cwd.description: Working directory for the command, relative to the workspace root
